description: Searches the full catalogue of available tools by keyword and returns the matching tool names with a short description. Use it when no directly-listed tool fits the task — many tools are available but not listed. Then call tool_schema for the one you picked, and run_tool to execute it.

query.description: Space-separated keywords, e.g. 'invoice pdf export'. Matched against tool names and descriptions; any term may match.

name: find_tools
title: Find tools
